summary.text: Ryan Pearson is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 19 since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Pearson attended American University and earned a B.S. in finance from Providence College.
His professional experience includes serving as an assistant vice president at RBS Citizens.
Pearson was assigned to the Senate Education Committee and the Senate Finance Committee in the 2021-2022 session.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026, and is on the ballot in the November 3 general election.
